save.text: Sam is en route; Liam is connected remotely via Internet video.
Matt and Marisha will guest at Tekko in Pittsburgh, Apr 8–10; panels and signings.
Confusion on Gilmore’s Glorious Goods shirt preorder deadline: likely tomorrow night, but to be safe they advise ordering tonight.
Two new shirts went up for preorder at 6:30 today; limited immediate stock; week-long preorder; working to expand size range.
Sam is voice directing DreamWorks’ Home TV cartoon; release in about a week.
Tonight is episode 47; episode 50 will be special with surprises and a post-50 Critmas blowout.
Marisha’s last episode as Signal Boost host airs Tuesday; hosts rotate; she continues as producer.
Liam is remotely connected and currently playing from his childhood kitchen, where he first played D&D.
Gern Blanston left to scavenge red dragon scales in the Cindergrove and hasn’t been seen since.
Scanlan cast Mordenkainen’s Magnificent Mansion, inviting the Pyrah tribe inside for safe lodging.
The mansion manifested with ethereal servants; Grog attacked some, dispersing three attendants.
About 35 Pyrah (including Zephrah) are present; Scanlan can designate them to enter.
Scanlan confirms MMM is a newly learned skill; 100 servants—50 assigned to him, rest available to party.
Food/drink/items vanish if taken outside the mansion; servants can manifest items solid inside.
Liam is remote via video; Sam/Scanlan’s mansion has individual rooms for party; Pike and Kaylie have reserved rooms near Scanlan’s.
MMM door is invite-only; casting takes 1 minute; usable once per day per Scanlan.
Keyleth returns with more Pyrah; servants assist; some Pyrah keep building for post-departure lodging.
Trinket gets lodging in mansion basement training area with high ceilings; Vex moves her bed there; Grog plans to train there.
Basement training chamber appears via doorway: sand pit, dummies, chains, basic weapons/armor; Grog trains there with Trinket.
MMM servants can clean; Vex decides to let servants handle cleaning after brief attempt with a broom.
Vex secretly tests a broom to see if it flies; tries commands; it doesn’t work and she stows it back in the Bag of Holding.
Vex stole Gern Blanston’s magical broom; initial secret tests failed until command word found.
Scanlan investigated the broom; identified hidden archaic Draconic activation word meaning “candle.”
Upon saying the word, the broom activated and lifted; Vex can now fly using it.
The Mansion room has ~50-ft ceilings; Vex test-flew the broom inside after recalling the Draconic command word and can control pitch/wobble with practice.
Vex agrees to a deal: Scanlan will pick someone for her to help someday to repay stealing Gern’s broom; both acknowledge the theft and intent to make amends.
In the night at the Mansion, Cerkonos visits Keyleth; his previously lost arm is visibly regenerating, and he requests to speak privately.

Cerkonos reveals Raishan—appearing human, arrived ~age 15 to Pyrah seeking redemption—secretly wielded ancient arcane power, tore open the Fire Ashari Gate months ago, releasing Thordak; she then vanished. He feels responsible and warns Keyleth to trust instincts.
Raishan is confirmed as the green dragon named during the Conclave’s attack on Emon; Keyleth recognizes the name.
Cerkonos offers Pyrah’s future aid and expresses faith in Keyleth’s leadership; Keyleth agrees to watch for news of Raishan.
At breakfast in Scanlan’s Mansion, Vex openly admits to the group she stole Gern Blanston’s magic broom and intends to keep it because it lets her fly.
Scanlan confirms uncertainty whether items left in Mordenkainen’s Mansion persist after it ends; group jokes about testing but does not attempt it.
Grog wakes from a disturbing dream of mass slaughter, Kevdak’s approval, and the Herd kneeling; he wakes shaken in the Mansion morning.
Vex test-flies Gern’s broom during Mansion breakfast, manages one turkey shot at disadvantage, then fumbles; needs practice to fight while flying.
Percy agrees to engineer a seat/stabilizer for Vex’s broom; may need funding and begins sketching.
Keyleth says she doesn’t care about the broom anymore but warns Vex not to die for greed; Vex says she’s not afraid to die after seeing the other side.

Keyleth shares Cerkonos’s account: Raishan infiltrated the Fire Ashari in human guise (~age 15), hid her power, then ripped open the Pyrah rift; Thordak’s release followed; she vanished; Ashari hadn’t known she was a dragon.
Party reaffirms Raishan is the green dragon; she infiltrated as a human among the Fire Ashari and likely instigated the Conclave plan years in the making; trust no one suggested.
Next objectives discussed: confront Kevdak for Titanstone Knuckles of Kord (Grog’s Herd) and consult a sphinx (boyfriend of the other sphinx); debate order vs. library first.
Group chooses to head toward Westruun, which is on the way to both Grog’s Herd territory and the Frostweald/sphinx lead; plan shifts to pursue Grog’s Herd first.

Grog explains exile: defied his Herd by sparing a harmless old bearded traveler; Uncle forced him to fight cousin (Grog won), then Uncle beat Grog nearly to death; Herd believes Grog is dead; Uncle (Kevdak) holds Titanstone Knuckles.
Percy suggests using Scanlan’s Hat of Disguise to avoid immediate confrontation with the Herd; Grog refuses, insisting he won’t hide.
Plan shifts again: aim for Frostweald/sphinx first to seek Vestiges before confronting Grog’s uncle/Kevdak and the Herd.
Grog says Herd custom likely requires one-on-one challenge for Titanstone Knuckles; he’s confident vs Uncle but wants extra items first.
Westruun is under threat from Umbrasyl (black dragon) lairing in Gatshadow north of the city; Bramblewood Forest and Crossroads trees are nearest safe-ish teleport targets.
Travel choice changed: Keyleth Teleported via Tree to Bramblewood edge near Westruun, then cast Wind Walk to fly south toward Frostweald; party opted Bramblewood over Crossroads for proximity.

On exiting Bramblewood in Wind Walk, they observed between forest and north Westruun: a 15–20 ft dirt mound area with wood spikes, shiny objects, haphazard grooves; two people hauling a cart away from it.
Uncertainty corrected: No wyverns noticed over Westruun in scry; party considered risk but proceeded.
Westruun dirt mound confirmed as dragon offering site; sweeping claw marks; coins scattered; ambush idea floated.
While Wind Walk coasting around Westruun: burned patterned farmlands; some farms active; each farm watched by armed guard; thin outer wall/battlements around city entrances.
Party landed from Wind Walk in high-crop field near Westruun; Vax signaled to descend; Vex cast Pass Without Trace; group stealthed successfully (all high rolls).
In high crops near Westruun, party debates freeing farmers; fear killing guards worsens famine or triggers reprisals; decide intel first; stealth intact.
Local farmer Reginald (bruised) says: dragon disliked; worse are his enforcers taking food and captives; his daughter taken; captives held in/near city and at an outskirt farm post.
Dragon seen over Westruun every couple days; last sighting dusk yesterday (~half day ago per Reginald).
